strategy.text: (1) ATTACK? Milotic is a bulky Water staller, very likely to attack or status: Scald (most likely, resisted by Rotom-Wash), Ice Beam (coverage, neutral), Toxic/Recover (stall). Most likely Scald, moderate confidence — it wants chip+potential burn on Oranguru. (2) SWITCH? Unlikely to switch; it just entered and has favorable matchup stalling a Psychic type. (3) THEIR READ OF ME: knows Oranguru packs Focus Blast (huge Fighting damage), so it will be wary of the Fighting coverage and likely stay in to wear me down / status me, rather than switch something weak to Fighting. (4) MY OPTIONS: Rotom-Wash is the clean switch — Electric/Water resists Scald and Ice Beam neutral, eats everything comfortably (17-20% Scald, 13-15% Ice Beam, immune to Toxic... actually Toxic lands but Rotom can Defog/Volt Switch later; Volt Switch immediately pressures Milotic for super-effective damage + momentum). Cost of switching: forfeit turn, Rotom eats the hit — but takes almost nothing. Gain: immediate super-effective Volt Switch pressure and a wall that Milotic struggles to break. Confident in read (Milotic wants to status/stall, not blow itself up). Not behind — I'm at full team, 5 healthy. Steadier alternative: attack with Oranguru (Focus Blast 1x now, Psychic risks Competitive boost). Switch is clearly better than staying in with a Focus Blast that misses 30% vs a stall wall. (5) MOST LIKELY + RESPONSE: Milotic clicks Scald; my Rotom-Wash comes in, takes ~20%, then Volt Switches next turn for super-effective pressure. Falsifier: if Milotic uses a strong Special attack that chunks Rotom oddly, or reveals Hidden Power/other coverage. (6) SEQUENCE: Rotom switches in eating Scald (~80% left); next turn I Volt Switch into a strong answer or stay and press the super-effective Electric.

strategy.text: (1) ATTACK? Milotic is a bulky wall — likely Scald (burn threat), Ice Beam, Toxic, or Recover. It won't be trying to KO Oranguru (Focus Blast only did 71% to Beartic, and Milotic is bulky). Most likely Scald or a status move to cripple my pivot. (2) SWITCH? No, Milotic just switched in and has no reason to switch out vs Oranguru. (3) THEIR READ OF ME: knows Oranguru (Focus Blast spammer), hasn't seen my bench. (4) MY OPTIONS: Staying Oranguru is bad (can't break Milotic's SpD, risks burn/Toxic). Rotom-Wash is the clean answer — resists Scald, eats Ice Beam (13-15%)/Scald (17-20%) comfortably, Choice Scarf out-speeds, and can Volt Switch (chip ~41-49% + pivot) or Trick the Scarf onto Milotic to permanently cripple a Recover/status-stall set. Primarina resists Water but Moonblast only ~32-38% and lacks the pivot. Rotom is clearly best. (5) MOST LIKELY ACTION + RESPONSE: Milotic Scalds or Toxics/Trick-baits; Rotom switch-in survives all and immediately threatens Volt Switch or Trick. Falsifier: if Milotic reveals a surprise Electric coverage (unlikely, not in movepool). (6) SEQUENCE: I switch Rotom-Wash in, eat Milotic's move, then next turn Volt Switch out (chip ~45%) or Trick to lock it. Rotom survives comfortably.

strategy.text: (1) ATTACK? Milotic likely attacks with Scald (STAB, threatens burn) or Ice Beam, or uses Toxic/Recover to stall. Its best play vs Oranguru is Scald/Ice Beam. Confidence medium — a bulky Water loves to click Scald for the burn/spread and to chip. (2) SWITCH? Unlikely to switch; Milotic just came in and has a good matchup vs Oranguru. (3) THEIR READ: it knows Oranguru has Focus Blast (2x SE on Beartic) and is a special attacker at 63%; it will treat Oranguru as a broken/semi-healthy mon it can pressure with Scald. It has not seen my bench. (4) MY OPTIONS: Staying in is bad — Shadow Ball only does 13-16% to Milotic while I eat 25-30% from Scald (with burn risk) — a losing trade. Switching to Rotom-Wash costs the turn (eats 13-20% from Scald/Ice Beam, both resisted; Toxic/Recover do nothing) and gains a big threat: Rotom outspeeds Milotic (271 vs <287) and Volt Switch is 2x SE for 34-41%, plus it walls Milotic's STAB entirely. This is the steadiest, highest-value line — I am NOT behind, and I punish their almost-certain Scald/Ice Beam. (5) MOST LIKELY: Scald/Ice Beam; my response is the Rotom-Wash switch which eats it safely. Falsifier: if Milotic reveals something unexpected (e.g. no Scald/Ice Beam, or a Mirror Coat). (6) SEQUENCE: I switch Rotom-Wash in (eats ~13-20%), then next turn Volt Switch for ~40% (Rotom outspeeds) and pivot/hold momentum.
